points.title: 家学渊源
points.description: 司马迁出生于陕西韩城的一个史官世家，其父司马谈曾任太史令。从小受到良好的教育，十岁便能诵读古文，二十岁开始游历天下，考察历史遗迹。这段时期，他广泛阅读典籍，拜访名师，为后来的史学事业奠定了坚实基础。司马谈临终前嘱咐司马迁继承史官职责，撰写一部贯通古今的史书，这一嘱托成为司马迁毕生的使命。
points.descriptionEn: Sima Qian was born in Hancheng, Shaanxi into a family of historians. His father, Sima Tan, served as the Grand Historian. From a young age, Sima Qian received excellent education and could read ancient texts by age ten. At twenty, he began traveling throughout China, studying historical sites. During this period, he extensively read classics and visited renowned scholars, laying a solid foundation for his later historical work. Before his death, Sima Tan entrusted Sima Qian with the mission of continuing the family's historical duties and writing a comprehensive history spanning ancient times to the present, a task that became Sima Qian's lifelong pursuit.

points.title: 仕途初显
points.description: 司马迁进入长安，初任郎中，后升为太史令。在此期间，他得以接触皇家藏书，博览群书，收集了大量史料。他还随汉武帝东巡封禅，参与制定历法改革，表现出卓越的学识和政治才能。司马迁广泛游历全国，考察各地风土人情，收集民间传说和历史资料，为《史记》的写作积累了丰富的素材。这段经历使他对历史有了更全面、更深入的理解，也坚定了他完成父亲遗志的决心。
points.descriptionEn: Sima Qian arrived in Chang'an and initially served as Gentleman of the Interior, later promoted to Grand Historian. During this time, he gained access to the imperial library, extensively studied various texts, and collected numerous historical materials. He accompanied Emperor Wu on eastern tours for imperial sacrifices and participated in calendar reforms, demonstrating his profound knowledge and political abilities. Sima Qian traveled extensively throughout the country, studying local customs and collecting folk tales and historical data, accumulating rich materials for his work 'Records of the Grand Historian'. This period deepened his understanding of history and strengthened his determination to fulfill his father's dying wish.

points.title: 李陵之祸
points.description: 公元前99年，司马迁因替投降匈奴的将军李陵辩护而触怒汉武帝，被判处宫刑。这一人生重大打击使司马迁一度陷入绝望，但他最终选择忍辱负重，继续完成《史记》的写作。在狱中，他发愤著书，将个人遭遇与历史研究相结合，使《史记》的思想深度和艺术成就达到新的高度。司马迁在《报任安书》中表达了自己'究天人之际，通古今之变，成一家之言'的史学理想，展现了他在逆境中的坚韧品格和崇高追求。
points.descriptionEn: In 99 BC, Sima Qian angered Emperor Wu by defending General Li Ling, who had surrendered to the Xiongnu. He was sentenced to castration, a devastating blow that plunged him into despair. However, he chose to endure humiliation and continue writing the 'Records of the Grand Historian'. In prison, he devoted himself to his work, combining his personal experiences with historical research, elevating the work's ideological depth and artistic achievement. In his 'Letter to Ren An', Sima Qian expressed his historical ideals of 'investigating the relationship between heaven and man, understanding the changes through time, and establishing a unique scholarly perspective', demonstrating his resilience and noble aspirations in the face of adversity.

points.title: 著述史记
points.description: 出狱后，司马迁以中书令的身份继续完成《史记》的写作。他历时十余年，完成了中国第一部纪传体通史《史记》，全书共130篇，52万余字，记载了从黄帝到汉武帝时期约3000年的历史。《史记》开创了纪传体史书的先河，包括本纪、世家、列传、书、表五种体例，全面系统地记录了政治、经济、文化、军事等各方面历史。司马迁在书中不仅客观记录历史，还通过'太史公曰'的形式表达自己的历史见解，体现了'不虚美，不隐恶'的史学精神，对后世史学发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After his release, Sima Qian continued writing the 'Records of the Grand Historian' as Palace Secretary. Over more than a decade, he completed China's first general history in biographical annals format, consisting of 130 chapters and over 520,000 characters, covering approximately 3,000 years of history from the Yellow Emperor to Emperor Wu. The 'Records' pioneered the biographical annals style of historical writing, including five formats: Basic Annals, Hereditary Houses, Biographies, Treatises, and Tables. It comprehensively recorded political, economic, cultural, and military aspects of history. Sima Qian not only objectively recorded history but also expressed his historical insights through the form of 'The Grand Historian Comments', embodying the historical spirit of 'not praising without merit, not concealing evil', profoundly influencing the development of later historiography.

points.title: 晚年影响
points.description: 《史记》完成后，司马迁的生平事迹记载较少，但其著作影响深远。他的史学思想和写作方法被后世史学家奉为典范，《史记》成为'二十四史'之首，对中国史学发展产生了不可估量的影响。司马迁开创的纪传体史书体例被后世史书沿袭，成为中国古代史学的主流形式。他的'究天人之际，通古今之变'的史学理念，以及'不虚美，不隐恶'的实录精神，成为中国史学传统的重要组成部分。司马迁的《史记》不仅是一部历史巨著，也是一部文学经典，其生动的人物刻画和优美的文笔对后世文学创作也产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After completing the 'Records', details of Sima Qian's later life are scarce, but his work had profound influence. His historical thought and writing methods were revered as models by later historians, and the 'Records' became the first of the Twenty-Four Histories, exerting immeasurable influence on Chinese historiography. The biographical annals format he pioneered was adopted by subsequent historical works, becoming the mainstream form of ancient Chinese historiography. His historical philosophy of 'investigating the relationship between heaven and man, understanding the changes through time' and his spirit of 'not praising without merit, not concealing evil' became essential components of Chinese historical tradition. The 'Records' is not only a great historical work but also a literary classic, and its vivid character portrayals and elegant prose have had a profound impact on later literary creation.

supporter.zh: 司马迁被誉为'史圣'，是中国史学奠基人。他开创的纪传体史书体例，以及'究天人之际，通古今之变'的宏大历史视野，使《史记》成为不朽史学经典。在遭受宫刑之辱后仍坚持完成巨著，展现了非凡的毅力和人格力量。司马迁的'不虚美，不隐恶'的实录精神，为中国史学树立了客观公正的典范，其史学思想和写作方法影响了中国两千多年的史学传统。
supporter.en: Sima Qian is revered as the 'Sage of History' and the founder of Chinese historiography. The biographical annals format he pioneered and his grand historical perspective of 'investigating the relationship between heaven and man, understanding the changes through time' made the 'Records of the Grand Historian' an immortal classic. His perseverance in completing the great work after suffering castration demonstrates extraordinary willpower and personal strength. His spirit of 'not praising without merit, not concealing evil' established an objective and fair model for Chinese historiography, and his historical thought and writing methods have influenced Chinese historical tradition for over two thousand years.

critic.zh: 批评者认为司马迁的《史记》存在明显的个人偏见，特别是对汉武帝的记载多有批评，反映了其个人遭遇带来的情绪影响。部分历史学家指出，司马迁在处理某些历史事件时过于强调个人道德评价，而忽视了客观历史背景的分析。此外，《史记》中的一些记载缺乏足够的史料支持，存在传说与史实混杂的问题。司马迁的史学方法虽然开创性，但在史料考证的严谨性上仍有不足，影响了部分历史记载的准确性。
critic.en: Critics argue that the 'Records of the Grand Historian' contains obvious personal biases, particularly in its criticism of Emperor Wu, reflecting the emotional impact of Sima Qian's personal experiences. Some historians point out that when dealing with certain historical events, Sima Qian overemphasized personal moral evaluations while neglecting analysis of objective historical contexts. Additionally, some records in the 'Records' lack sufficient historical support, mixing legends with historical facts. Although Sima Qian's historiographical methods were pioneering, they had deficiencies in the rigor of historical verification, affecting the accuracy of some historical accounts.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，司马迁是中国史学史上承前启后的关键人物，他开创的纪传体史书体例被后世史书沿袭，成为中国古代史学的主流形式。《史记》不仅是一部历史巨著，也是一部文学经典，其'太史公曰'的评论形式体现了史家主体意识的觉醒。在流行文化中，司马迁被视为知识分子的精神象征，其'忍辱负重'的形象激励着后世无数文人学者。他的史学思想和写作方法已经超越了时代限制，成为世界史学宝库中的珍贵遗产。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Sima Qian is a pivotal figure in Chinese historiography, bridging past and future. The biographical annals format he pioneered was adopted by subsequent historical works, becoming the mainstream form of ancient Chinese historiography. The 'Records' is not only a great historical work but also a literary classic, and its 'The Grand Historian Comments' form reflects the awakening of historical consciousness. In popular culture, Sima Qian is regarded as a spiritual symbol of intellectuals, and his image of 'enduring humiliation to fulfill a mission' has inspired countless scholars throughout history. His historical thought and writing methods have transcended temporal limitations, becoming a precious heritage in the world's historiography.

self.zh: 人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛，用之所趋异也。
self.en: Everyone must die, but some deaths are weightier than Mount Tai, while others are lighter than a goose feather; it all depends on the cause for which one dies.

others.zh: 自谓究天人之际，通古今之变，成一家之言。其文直，其事核，不虚美，不隐恶，故谓之实录。
others.en: He claimed to have investigated the relationship between heaven and man, understood the changes through time, and established a unique scholarly perspective. His writing is straightforward, his accounts are factual, he does not praise without merit nor conceal evil, thus it is called a true record.
